description: This Java source file defines the class MqttContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider, which provides methods to determine tenant and authentication ID information from an MQTT context, including handling SSL certificates and authentication headers.

classes.name: MqttContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to determine tenant and auth ID from MQTT context, handling SSL certificates and authentication headers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant and auth ID information based on the MQTT context, using certificate or auth header if required.

methods.name: getTenantViaCert
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve tenant info from SSL client certificate if SSL is used.

methods.name: getTenantFromAuthHeader
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve tenant info from the MQTT authentication header.
